t: Neutral-Atom Quantum Computer: Rydberg Blockade Calculator — Simple
name: Neutral-Atom Quantum Computer: Rydberg Blockade Calculator — Simple
title: Neutral-Atom Quantum Computer: Rydberg Blockade Calculator — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Rydberg atoms block each other: within the blockade radius, one excitation forbids another — the mechanism of two-qubit gates. The calculator computes the radius from the Rydberg state's C6 coefficient and the Rabi frequency.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Blockade radius scaling: 2x Rabi -> 0.89x radius = 0.891 factor. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The Neutral-Atom Quantum Computer: Laser Detuning vs. Fixed Wavelength Band
real_world_basis: Blockade-radius math is the real basis of Rydberg quantum computing.
signature_version: Signature version: the fixed-wavelength blockade desk — the chapter's Fixed Wavelength Band as the uniformity target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the Rabi frequency must be uniform across the array — calibrate it.
math_note: Blockade radius scaling: 2x Rabi -> 0.89x radius: 0.891 factor [verified]; Atoms in blockade sphere at 5 µm radius, 3 µm spacing: 19 atoms [verified]

math_check.label: Atoms in blockade sphere at 5 µm radius, 3 µm spacing

safety: Laser safety: Rydberg excitation lasers are classified — interlocks mandatory.
how_it_works: Compute R_b = (C6/Ω)^(1/6) for the state and drive strength. The demo blockades a rubidium array.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time
